task: Wire the Restaurant scene (src/minigames/restaurant/index.js) to the new order-blind conveyor and the belt-sharing Challenge rival.
requirements: Conveyor: stop passing order demand. Call conveyor.advance(serviceDt) with no view; remove dueConveyorOrders, filler handling and any readiness/prep gating of belt supply (customer.readyFired / prepRemaining must no longer affect what enters the belt). Belt dishes need no filler flag. Temperature still starts at pickup. The dish return still just removes the carried dish.

Rival model: create it with the scene's conveyor (createRestaurantRival({ ..., conveyor })) and consume the new data-only events from src/minigames/restaurant/rival.js: targetCustomer, abandonTarget, claimCustomer, orderTaken, targetDish { customer, dishId, food, position, from, delay, duration, speed }, abandonDish { customer, dishId, reason }, pickUpDish { customer, dishId, food, position }, deliverToCustomer, servedCustomer, abandonTask { customer, reason, discardedDish }. Remove every use of the removed events and objects: walkToPass, dishReady, pass pickups, the rival hatch anchor/opening/dish mesh, RIVAL_HATCH_POSITION and hatch debug fields.

Physical race: a targetDish walk animates the rival character to the belt-front intercept position over the event's delay + duration, facing its path (existing steering). On pickUpDish, remove that dish's scene mesh from the belt and show it in the rival's hands (reuse the carry-anchor approach used for the player). On abandonDish the rival stops and re-plans (the next event drives it). On abandonTask with discardedDish, hide the carried mesh. A dish the rival carries is never pickable or deliverable by the player.

First contact wins: in each controller update resolve the player's pickup (keyboard action, click-to-walk arrival) BEFORE calling rival.advance, so a same-frame race goes to the player; conveyor.take is atomic, so the loser's take returns null. When the player takes a dish the rival had targeted, the rival model notices on its next advance (it abandons with reason 'taken') — do not special-case it in the scene.
Remove the Challenge 'extra hand above the player limit while the rival is free' logic only if it references the removed pass/dish state; otherwise keep it unchanged.

Talk: keep the press-to-talk flow already in index.js. Small fix: commit the Restaurant reservation BEFORE the microphone starts. src/systems/speech.js currently calls target.onCommit from onStarted (after recognition.start). Change it so onCommit runs inside onPress before starting, and if onCommit returns false (reservation refused) no session starts; keep mic-free behaviour (onCommit then onFallback). Update the speech test that covers onCommit ordering.
Debug surface window.__eslDebug.restaurant: rival { state, targetCustomer, targetDishId, carriedDish, position }, conveyor snapshot as today, and remove hatch fields. Keep carried.dishId.
